back: Oxidation Is Loss (of electrons), Reduction Is Gain.
Oxidising agent is reduced (gains e⁻); reducing agent is oxidised (loses e⁻).

front: Where do oxidation and reduction happen?
back: Oxidation at the anode, reduction at the cathode — in every cell.
Voltaic: spontaneous, chemical → electrical, anode −. Electrolytic: non-spontaneous, electrical → chemical, anode +.
1°: aldehyde (distil) → acid (reflux). 2°: ketone. 3°: none. Orange → green.
NaBH₄/LiAlH₄: aldehyde → 1° alcohol, ketone → 2° alcohol; LiAlH₄ for acids.
